answers.core: Efficient data passing is a core graphics need. Textures work for some cases but are not optimal for all data. SSBO fills this gap and brings Godot up to par with other modern engines.
answers.workaround: This could be worked around by encoding data in textures, but that is less flexible and optimal. Uniforms are limited to single values. SSBO provides the right level of abstraction.

title: Add support for Shader Storage Buffer Objects (SSBO)
